_readme: Starter criteria library for Green Key Readiness (Hotels & Hostels). Titles and guidance are short Triple i paraphrases, NOT the Green Key criteria text. Only the criteria named in the product spec (section 5.3) are seeded; the domain owner completes the library through the Criteria library page (add / edit / import JSON or CSV). Types marked provisional must be confirmed against the official criteria by the domain owner. Rule keys inside 'applicability' are read by services/gk/applicability.js (minEmployees, maxEmployees, requiresFacility, excludesFacility, notSeasonal, seasonalOnly, countries, excludeCountries, typeByEmployees, naAllowedWithJustification) and services/gk/readiness.js (evidenceMaxAgeMonths, reviewEveryMonths).

2026-2031.title: Named sustainability representative and substitute
2026-2031.guidance: Name one person responsible for the programme and one substitute. Both should be permanent staff. Keep a record when either changes.

2026-2031.title: Documented strategic sustainability targets
2026-2031.guidance: Set measurable targets: four or more for establishments above 50 employees, otherwise two or more, spread over at least two areas. Horizon of six years at most, baseline taken from real data, document less than two years old and reviewed each certification period.

2026-2031.title: Two-year action plan linked to the targets
2026-2031.guidance: Plan concrete actions (four or more above 50 employees, otherwise two or more) over 24 months, split by year. Each action needs a way to measure it, an owner, a deadline and a link to a target. Explain any action not completed and give the next step.

2026-2031.title: Staff grievance channel
2026-2031.guidance: Offer staff a way to raise concerns safely and record how they are handled. Becomes imperative above 50 employees.

2026-2031.title: Indigenous Peoples assessment (100 km radius)
2026-2031.guidance: Assess whether Indigenous Peoples live within 100 km. If none are present, mark the criterion not applicable and store the assessment as justification.

2026-2031.title: Fair recruitment and staff development
2026-2031.guidance: Show that hiring and staff development follow fair, non-discriminatory practice. Becomes imperative above 50 employees. Use attestations; do not upload payroll documents.

2026-2031.title: Regular staff sustainability briefings
2026-2031.guidance: Brief staff at least twice a year (once if seasonal or five staff or fewer). Keep the topic, date and attendance, and move the content forward each year.

2026-2031.title: Staff sustainability training
2026-2031.guidance: Hold one general and one department-specific training each year and train new hires within four weeks of starting.

2026-2031.title: Guest information on low-carbon transport
2026-2031.guidance: Tell guests about public transport, cycling and walking options. Check that the information is still correct twice a year.

2026-2031.title: Monthly water consumption records
2026-2031.guidance: Record total water use per source every month for the last two calendar years (first-time applicants: the previous full year or at least three months; six months during the transition). Document the method, flag estimates, keep permits for non-public sources and investigate large changes.
